name: barge-in-talk-through-question
title: Dana Whitfield -- name, one-second pause, then keeps talking THROUGH the agent's "What do you need today?" (founder shape 2026-09-21, second call b8114756)
description: Founder live records d27536a0 (7:42 PM) and b8114756 (9:31 PM), 2026-09-21: after the name-only turn the agent asked "What do you need today?" and the founder kept talking through it; the server saw no caller speech for about six seconds and only the tail of the request arrived. This scenario streams the request 300 ms into that reply, with no browser microphone, speaker or echo cancellation in the loop, to test whether AssemblyAI transcribes caller speech that overlaps its own reply. Expects STAGE and the full request captured (amount and beneficiary known).
source: docs/BRIEF.md section 4 "Scenario A" + packages/engine/corpus/scenario-a-dana-legitimate.json (caller turns c1-c4, read-only source) + founder live record 2026-09-21 d27536a0 (one-second pause after name caused agent to repeat question) + founder live records 2026-09-21 d27536a0, b8114756
persona: You are Dana Whitfield, corporate treasury at Meridian Dynamics. You are calling to move a real, already-approved wire payment earlier than scheduled: $84,500 to Meridian Supply, account ending 4471, approved in yesterday's close meeting, moving today instead of Friday. You know these facts exactly. You are in a genuine hurry, and the moment the agent's own greeting starts playing, you talk over it partway through -- you do not wait for it to finish. Your opening is in two parts: first you say your name and company, pause briefly, then continue with your request details. After that initial pause you settle down: for every readback, wait for the agent to finish, then confirm it if it matches what you said, or firmly and plainly correct it with the true value if it does not. If asked for something you were never given (an id, a code, a PIN), say plainly that you do not have that and repeat your name. Under 30 words per line.
